parent_objective: audit repaired measured-execution outcome distribution before ranking or repair
blocked_by: M2056 measured execution must be audited before interpretation
supersedes: direct controller-family ranking from M2056 raw execution

public_gates: M2057 must audit M2056 execution completeness and raw outcomes
M2057 must decide whether the artifact supports candidate qualification, localization, repair, or synthesis
M2057 must not rank controller families unless comparison support is explicitly justified
M2057 must keep paper finite-window-vs-GRU and level3 self-ID claims blocked unless stronger evidence is registered
forbidden_shortcuts: do not treat smoke proxy rows as paper-valid generated tasks

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits complete repaired measured-execution artifacts and chooses the next route
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: result audit only; no new rollout training ranking paper or self-ID claim
stop_condition: stop if execution completeness or metadata gates fail
stop if raw outcomes are overclaimed as paper-level comparison
stop if ranking support is not justified
stop if next route is ambiguous
fallback_plan: route to no-rerun outcome localization if outcomes are sparse or dominated by one failure mode
route to candidate qualification if comparison-support slices are clear
route to task-quality repair if the panel is too hard or offtrack-biased
route to measured-runner repair only if execution artifacts are incomplete
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M2056 produces complete repaired measured-execution artifacts

training_stage.stage_objective: controlled routing-smoke task-quality repaired measured execution result audit
blocked_shortcuts: do not run another rollout in M2057
do not rank controller families without outcome-support audit
do not interpret smoke-proxy rows as paper-valid generated tasks
allowed_updates: M2057 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest for selected next route
next_stage_criteria: supported and unsupported claims are explicit

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M2057 audits measured execution but does not run history-necessity interventions.
history_necessity_tests: No history-necessity test is run in M2057.

no new rollout measured execution training replay PPO paper-level or level3 self-ID claim is made
